title: Hi, I’m Mehreen 👋
text:
Data scientist. Mother. Traveller.
I’m Mehreen Ali Gillani, a data scientist based in New York City, finishing my MS in Data Science at CUNY.
My path hasn’t been a straight line. I started out as a network performance engineer at Nokia Siemens Networks, digging into telecom KPI data to find out why networks slowed down. I then did research on 4G networks and published work in the ACM Digital Library. After that, I spent ten years as a full-time mom. In 2024 I came back to tech, and this time I chose data science.
Being a mother taught me patience and how to explain hard things simply. Travelling taught me to stay curious about how the world works. I bring both into how I do data science.

title: Hi, I’m Mehreen 👋
text:
What you’ll find here
Data with Mehreen is where I share what I’ve learned, in plain English:

🧪 One mini project every week on real public datasets
🤖 Machine learning and AI: from regression and recommender systems to evaluating LLMs
📊 Python, R, SQL and dashboards in Streamlit and Shiny
💡 Lessons from returning to tech after a career break

Whether you’re starting out, switching careers or coming back after time away, I hope this helps you learn alongside me.
